community.title: SS26 Drop 1 – The Story Behind the Collection
community.excerpt: Every piece in Drop 1 was designed around a single idea: movement through culture.
community.content:
Every piece in Drop 1 was designed around a single idea: movement through culture. We spent months researching the streets, listening to the community, and crafting garments that feel as intentional as they look.

From the olive heavy hoodie to the rust bomber — each piece tells a part of the story. Shop the full drop now before it sells out.
community.author: Others.

shipping.content:
Shipping

We offer free standard shipping on all orders over €150. Standard delivery takes 3–5 business days within Europe. Express shipping (1–2 business days) is available at checkout for €12.95.

Returns

We accept returns within 30 days of delivery. Items must be unworn, unwashed, and in original packaging. To start a return, email us at returns@others.store with your order number.

Refunds are processed within 5–7 business days of receiving the returned item.

faq.question: What sizes do you carry?
faq.answer: We carry sizes S through XXL on most items. Size guides are available on each product page.

faq.question: How long does shipping take?
faq.answer: Standard shipping takes 3–5 business days within Europe. Express options are available at checkout.

faq.question: Can I return or exchange an item?
faq.answer: Yes. We accept returns within 30 days of delivery for unworn, unwashed items in original packaging.

faq.question: Do you ship internationally?
faq.answer: Currently we ship within Europe. International shipping is coming soon.
